verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack describes screen sharing. Teams docs only say it delivers 'meetings, calling' (ms-teams-docs-18). Community hands-on reports do show the feature exists: users describe presenters sharing their desktop with an annotation mode (ms-teams-comm-4), and a screen-sharing button that is disabled in some Firefox builds (ms-teams-comm-19). That confirms the core capability but shows browser-specific limits and clunky live-collaboration tooling. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of in-call screen sharing, evidence of reliable cross-browser/client support, documented admin controls for sharing during calls.
